data.name: Rabee
data.gender_notes: Rabee is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who comes before others, early riser. The name Rabee carries the meaning “Early” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rabee usually hope their child will grow to embody early and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who wish to start their spiritual journey early in life.
data.etymology: Rabee belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Early.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rabee total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ربيع
in_arabic.meaning: ربيع يعني الربيع أو فصل الربيع باللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: ربيع هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الربيع أو فصل الربيع، و هو أحد الفصول الأربعة التي تتجدد فيها الحياة على الأرض. ورد اسم ربيع في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَالأَرْضِ وَرَبِّيهَا' (سورة البقرة: 61)، وقد أشتق اسم ربيع من الفعل 'رَبَعَ' الذي يعني الارتفاع أو الازدياد.

in_urdu.name: ربیع
in_urdu.meaning: ربیع کا مطلب ہے بہار یا موسم بہار
in_urdu.long_meaning: ربیع ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بہار یا موسم بہار، جو زندگی کی تجدید اور نشوونما کا موسم ہے۔ عربی میں 'رَبَعَ' فعل سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلند ہونا یا بڑھنا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں ربیع الاول اور ربیع الثاني دو مہینے ہیں جو محرم کے بعد آتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रबीع
in_hindi.meaning: रबीع का अर्थ है वसंत या बसंत ऋतु
in_hindi.long_meaning: रबीع एक मस्कलिन नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है। इसका अर्थ है वसंत या बसंत ऋतु, जो जीवन की नवीनीकरण और वृद्धि का मौसम है। अरबी में 'रबा' क्रिया से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचा होना या बढ़ना।

in_pashto.name: ربيع
in_pashto.meaning: ربيع د بہار یا د بهار موسم معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ربيع یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه راوتلی دی. دغه نوم د بہار یا د بهار موسم معنی لري، کوم چی د ژوند د نوي کولو او وده کولو موسم دی. په عربي ژبه کي 'رَبَعَ' کلمه څخه راوتلی دی چی معنی يې لوړيدل یا ډیریدل دي.

in_english.name: Rabee
in_english.long_meaning: Rabee is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'spring' or 'the spring season'. It symbolizes renewal, growth, and the cyclical nature of life. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'r-b-ʿ' which means 'to rise' or 'to increase'. In Islamic tradition, the name Rabee is associated with the spring season, which is considered a time of rejuvenation and spiritual growth. The name has been used in various Muslim cultures and is found in several forms across the Middle East, South Asia, and other regions.

historical_references.reference: Rabee' ibn Sabrah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who participated in several major battles during the early Islamic era. He was one of the ten companions who were given the title 'Ashare Mubashsharun' (the ten who were granted good news of Paradise).
historical_references.context: Early Islamic History, Companions of the Prophet (Sahabah)

historical_references.reference: Rabia al-Adawiyya, known as Rabia of Basra, was a renowned Sufi saint and poetess who lived during the early Islamic period. She is widely regarded as the first woman Sufi and is best known for her devotion and love for Allah. She is also known for her famous quote, 'I want to see Allah in the same way that I see my beloved.'
historical_references.context: Islamic History, Sufism, Women in Islam
